file_spec.value: For the general civil passport (ümumvətəndaş pasportu), the photograph is captured on-site by the issuing authority (ASAN service centers) in accordance with ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization) standards, together with fingerprints — it is not a self-prepared/self-submitted printed photo for standard issuance

size.note: The official ASAN xidmet (State Migration Service one-stop-shop) page for general civil passport issuance states the photo is taken in-person at the service center to ICAO standard, rather than specifying a self-prep print size. A separate official migration.gov.az page ('required documents for services') lists '2 photos sized 3x4 cm' but under a citizenship-establishment/residence-permit document list, not explicitly the standard civil passport renewal service — so this number was NOT carried into verified as a direct match/conflict for az-passport specifically, to avoid misattributing a figure from an adjacent service category. DB's 3×4cm / 2.5-3.0cm values were not directly confirmed or contradicted for this specific document.
